body:
Operator ruling (19:18 MST): STORY-1728 gets priority the moment it is ready, so it stops playing catch-up after every merge.

What this means for you:
- Push each slice the moment it's green locally (merge main, tests (a)+(c), make check-ci). Order: #2727, then #2730, then #2751. Each push triggers CI and an immediate review from me.
- If one combined PR is faster than serial slice PRs (#2727, then retarget #2730/#2751, then repeat), you may push the whole stack as one PR. Your call; say which.
- When each slice passes review, I ship it ahead of everything else in the queue. While a slice is in CI or review, I'll hold other ships that touch overlapping files (cli.rs, the command modules).

Reply on this thread with your ETA for #2727's push.
subject: Operator ruling: STORY-1728 stack ships FIRST
